raw_segments.text: No need to cower behind a gatepost, indeed. To peep up at chamber lattices, fearing life was a stir behind them.
No need to listen for doors opening, to fancy steps on the pavement or the gravel walk.
The lawn, the grounds were trodden in waste. The portal yawned void. The front was, as I had once seen it in a dream,
but a shell-like wall, very high and very fragile looking, perforated with painless windows. No roof, no battlements,
no chimneys, all had crashed in.
